comments.regular: Global god-mode state byte. SetGodMode writes it, GetGodMode returns it, and Cmd_ToggleGodMode_Execute toggles it while printing 'God Mode enabled/disabled.' PlayerCharacter post-shot AMMO consumption is one consumer that bypasses depletion while this is true.
